briefing: Mythos Gates briefing: Elite: Promise the Tír na nÓg Mirror Meadow: Key Verdict. Enter Tír na nÓg Mirror Meadow on Silver-Root Geas Labyrinth through The Silver-Root Gate while the Gate remains Sealed Gate with fae time bleed. Reference deity voice is Dagda, but the player still chooses one deity from the faction roster. Objective: With one selected deity, defeat the elite lock against Sídhe Thorn Knight inside the elite-tuned Tír na nÓg Mirror Meadow and prove the active deity can endure the trial alone.

missionIntro.speaker: Dagda Divine Voice
missionIntro.text: A geas is a road that remembers the foot that broke it. The Tír na nÓg Mirror Meadow will know whether one deity is enough.
missionIntro.speaker: Tuatha Deity Voice
missionIntro.text: The field asks for proof. One active deity enter, and The Thorn-Memory Gate will remember how we answer.

enemyIntroduction.speaker: Lore Director
enemyIntroduction.text: Enemies are not filler here; they are the elite pressure of Silver-Root Geas Labyrinth made hostile.

midBattle.speaker: Gameplay Director
midBattle.text: Read the room law first: Exploit or avoid the route rule: silver-root snares that remember previous steps

victory.speaker: Dagda Divine Voice
victory.text: The root remembers obedience and opens one more ring.
victory.speaker: Tuatha Deity Voice
victory.text: The Gate has not yielded. It has recorded that we did not break.

defeat.speaker: Dagda Divine Voice
defeat.text: Withdraw. The The Silver-Root Gate has learned too much from this attempt.
defeat.speaker: Tuatha Deity Voice
defeat.text: Fall back before the wound learns our full shape.

codex.speaker: Lore Director
codex.text: Avalora is the source Realm; mortal myth is only the later echo. This beat documents Tír na nÓg Mirror Meadow as part of Silver-Root Geas Labyrinth.

soloDeityPolicy: Dialogue supports one active battlefield deity; roster/Deity language is excluded from standard mission combat.
visualDirection: Frame Tír na nÓg Mirror Meadow as a elite node in Silver-Root Geas Labyrinth; silver branch crowns, moonlit green-gold, living bark armor, woven thorn mantles, mist veils, standing stone geometry, battle-crow omens, cauldron glow, druid knots as organic growth not decoration, geas scars, fae glass, root-lace anatomy.

mythosGatesDialogueRecreation.speakerRule: Use faction divine voice, Lore Director, or Gameplay Director; no playable deity language.
mythosGatesDialogueRecreation.soloRule: Dialogue supports one active god or goddess in the field.

soloDeityPolicy: Dialogue supports one active battlefield deity; roster/deity language is excluded from player-facing copy except legacy IDs.
